free_text: The patient is a 59-year-old male with an elevated PSA of 7.68 ng/mL and moderate LUTS. MRI demonstrated a focal area of restricted diffusion in the peripheral zone, but biopsies consistently showed a Gleason score of 0+0 (ISUP grade group 0). The competing illness is not specified. Management assessment is continued surveillance, balancing the risk of progression against the lack of definitive cancer evidence from the biopsy.
